white-noise-generator.workedExample:
Play pink noise for 30 minutes at 44,100 Hz.

Samples generated = 30 × 60 × 44,100 = 79,380,000 samples — synthesized live, never repeating.

Pink noise falls 3 dB per octave: if the 100 Hz band measures 60 dB, the 200 Hz band measures ~57 dB and the 400 Hz band ~54 dB — that gentle downward slope is why it sounds like soft rain instead of harsh static.

Safe listening: keep peaks under ~70 dB (about 40–50% volume on most phones) for all-night play.
